worldcombat.skill.afteryou.summary: Advance one nearby ally’s standard preparation, retaining at least one tick, or briefly wait for its next preparation. Players receive one native melee speed boost. Your recovery slows briefly.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.use.0: Let an ally act before your own beat
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.use.1: Pass the tempo over before an ally's big move
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.use.2: Flip the order of a combo
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.description.0: Wait for up to %1$s, then shorten one standard preparation by strength %2$s/(100+strength), retaining at least one tick. Each preparation receives help once. Players receive one native melee speed boost.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.description.1: Choose an ally within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.description.2: The helper yields for %1$s with %2$s negative skill haste, extending later cooldowns. Preparation %3$s, recovery %4$s, cooldown %5$s. Each side ends with its actual carrier.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.lead.0: Urge: tempo strength x1.2 and waiting window x0.7, for a stronger early advance.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.lead.1: Entrust: tempo strength x0.85 and waiting window x1.4, waiting longer for one useful preparation.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.timing: Cast on an ally: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.preference.le: Urge: strength x1.2, waiting window x0.7. Entrust: strength x0.85, waiting window x1.4. Both are used once.
worldcombat.skill.afteryou.preference.ai: The partner only considers handing off while an ally is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger walks over to help.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to hand off.
